m: Best with rice cooked the day before and chilled. If not, cook it early, spread on a tray and fridge it for an hour.
Slice the chicken small, toss with a splash of soy, and stir-fry in a very hot wok until cooked. Set aside.
Scramble the eggs softly, then set aside.
Stir-fry the diced carrot 2 minutes, then the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onion for 30 seconds.
Add the rice, press it into the wok and leave it 1 minute to toast before tossing. Repeat a few times.
Add the peas, chicken, egg, soy and oyster sauce. Toss hot for 2 minutes, finish with sesame oil and green spring onion.
l: Built for lunch. Reheat until piping hot.
g: Make the whole batch with tamari, and use a GF oyster sauce or skip it. Rice dishes are where hidden gluten sneaks in.
